## Learner problem and changed behavior

Explain what was confusing or broken, and what a learner can now do.

## Validation

- [ ] Offline tests and example runner pass.
- [ ] Ruff lint and formatting pass.
- [ ] Local links work and changed external sources were checked.
- [ ] Notebook outputs are cleared, if applicable.
- [ ] AWS changes include inventory, tags, IAM explanations, costs and teardown.

List the checks actually run, their results, and any live/platform checks not run. Do not claim deployment success from a mock or synth result.
